name: feature_card_a
prompt: One UI card frame for a cartoon ski-resort slot game's intro screen, on a fully transparent background, nothing else in the picture. It is a chunky wooden lodge notice board, upright (portrait, about 4 wide by 5 tall), seen flat from the front, filling the picture: a frame of thick rounded pine logs in warm orange-brown with darker grain lines and pale ringed cut ends at the four corners - the SAME log frame as the slot board and the jackpot board in the attached screenshot. Across the top, inside the frame, a wide carved wooden plank as the title header: a darker honey-brown board with a simple bevel, completely EMPTY (a title will be put on it later). Below the header the whole inside of the frame is ONE large plain panel in a very pale icy cream-white with the faintest pale-blue frost at its corners: flat, clean, EMPTY, no picture, no pattern - text will be put on it. A thick cap of white snow with pale blue shadow shapes sits along the top log and droops over its corners; a row of small icicles hangs from the top log over the header's upper edge and a few from the bottom log; little heaps of snow rest on the bottom corners. One small bright green cannabis leaf is pinned at the top left corner of the frame and a pine cone with a sprig of pine needles at the top right, as on the board in the screenshot. Drawn exactly in the screenshot's flat 2D adult-animation cartoon style: thick clean black outlines, flat solid colours with simple hard-edged shadow shapes, no realistic lighting, no 3D rendering, no gradients haze. ABSOLUTELY NO text, letters, numbers or symbols on the header or the panel. Symmetrical, tidy, premium game UI.
